limitations: Sleeve and washer dimensions are provisional envelopes, not sourced components or compression qualification.
Flat Cu plates need only profile cutting, drilling and M2 countersinks; no bent fingers or fitted jaws.
Steel blank has two broad contact pads only0.1mm proud of the upper front face; mica must not extend into the intended lower contacts.
M3 cable lug/bolt/nut outside upper block not modeled. Virtual copper annuli prescribe cable-clamp ports for later stationary solve.
Thread envelopes use matching nominal diameters without modeled thread teeth; actual tap drills, engagement and drill cones need manufacturing drawings.
Heater retention, clamping preload, magnetic carriers, external mounting/ground paths and clearances to actual lugs/leads unfinished.
Thermal constants provisional fixed inputs, not hot-property qualification. Do not run old integral thermal mode: it treats copper as stainless and omits mica.
All steel,Cu,fastener,insulator current/thermal paths must be retained in full assembly tests. Ideal CuSS contact is only an initial limit; proper interface resistance sensitivity required.
No GPU initial masks, electrical, thermal, jetting or operating-temperature result yet.
